operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Vocabulary expansion adds entries to the tokenizer and embedding-table schema; tokenize segments values using an existing vocabulary, lookup retrieves table rows, and update writes values at existing indexed positions.

operation_proposals.source_operation: expand the tokenizer vocabulary to include unique new tokens
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The documented operation is vocabulary-set and embedding-table expansion, which is distinct from tokenization, lookup, or indexed replacement of existing state.

operation_proposals.source_operation: replicate key label tokens by factor α
